messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to match the action in the motion reference video. Use the reference video only for the action. Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to match the reference video. Use the reference video only for the action. Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in the center of a street, initially facing forward. She then turns her head to the side, raises her right hand to her face, and places her left hand on her hip in a pose. She holds this pose for a few seconds before lowering her hand and returning to a neutral standing position.","camera":"The camera starts with a medium shot of the character's upper body and slowly zooms out to a full-body shot, revealing her entire outfit and the street environment. The camera remains static after the zoom.","clothing":"A white, short-sleeved romper with a floral pattern of pink and purple flowers and green leaves, featuring cold-shoulder cutouts and a V-neckline. She wears light-colored, flat shoes.","hair_color":"Dark red.","hairstyle":"Short, dark red hair with a small bun on top of her head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slender build, fair skin, and a youthful face.","scene":"A cobblestone street in a European-style town, with brick and stone buildings on either side. A Union Jack flag hangs from a building on the left, and a sign for 'KOWERS & FUTO & SAHACIA' is visible on the right. The lighting suggests a bright, overcast day."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output character now performs a similar sequence to the reference: standing, tilting the head, raising a hand to the face, placing the other hand on the hip, holding the pose, then lowering the hand and returning to a neutral stance. The character's red hair, floral romper, street scene, and overall camera framing remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to match the motion reference, while preserving identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the facial expression exactly matches the reference or remains unchanged from the source is difficult to judge from the frames.
unexpected_changes: The camera framing appears to start closer and zoom out slightly, whereas the source began with a wider full-body view.
